page.overview:
Who is Costin VI?

Emperor Costin VI was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 2075–2113 AG) during the Era of the Princes, succeeding his brother Sidir IX as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Costin was succeeded in 2113 by his brother Menemtahe V.
